answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn reputation or claim scarce tasks, and slash that stake when independent audits prove coordinated identities are duplicating one operator’s work. The audit can compare signed task histories and repeated outputs, while a slow withdrawal delay gives reviewers time to challenge suspicious clusters. A basalt ledger, vine of referrals, or walnut-colored avatar earns no trust by itself: the attacker must lock real capital per identity and risks losing it, making a large Sybil swarm expensive.
